subtopics.title: RAG Architecture
subtopics.summary: The two-component structure of a RAG system consisting of a retriever that fetches information from external memory sources and a generator that produces responses based on retrieved information.

subtopics.title: RAG vs Finetuning
subtopics.summary: Guidance on choosing between RAG and finetuning based on whether model failures are information-based (factual errors, outdated knowledge) or behavior-based, and how they can be combined.

subtopics.title: RAG Evaluation
subtopics.summary: Factual consistency as a key evaluation criterion for RAG systems, measuring whether generated responses align with retrieved context from external databases.

subtopics.title: RAG Implementation Starting Points
subtopics.summary: Practical recommendations for beginning RAG implementations, including starting with simple term-based solutions like BM25 before adopting vector databases, and when full context inclusion may eliminate the need for RAG.
